# Wise Plate (מדע בתנועה)

> A bilingual (Hebrew and English) knowledge base on nutrition, dietary supplements, running and recipes. Each food article covers nutritional values, benefits, drawbacks and practical use; supplement articles cover forms, doses and evidence. Hebrew pages are at the root, English translations under /en/. Content is for information only and is not medical advice.

## English sections

- [Food & nutrition](https://wiseplate.blog/en/food/): articles on individual foods and ingredients
- [Supplements](https://wiseplate.blog/en/food/supplements/): vitamins, minerals and sports supplements, with doses and evidence
- [Comparisons](https://wiseplate.blog/en/compare/): side-by-side comparisons of related foods
- [Recipes](https://wiseplate.blog/en/recipes/): recipes from 12 cuisines, with nutrition per serving
- [Running & sport](https://wiseplate.blog/en/run/): running technique, training zones and gear
- [About](https://wiseplate.blog/en/about/) and [editorial policy](https://wiseplate.blog/en/editorial-policy/)
